a:r.a:t: I want to be upfront about what Rift doesn't support.

Rift is focused on HTTP and HTTPS. It doesn't support Mountebank's TCP, SMTP, or LDAP protocols. If you have services that mock raw TCP connections or email servers, you'll need to keep Mountebank for those.

One behavior is intentionally not supported: shellTransform, which executes shell commands. This was a security decision - we don't want test configurations executing arbitrary shell commands. The decorate behavior with JavaScript covers the same use cases safely.

For most teams, this isn't a limitation. The vast majority of service virtualization is HTTP-based API mocking. If you have a few non-HTTP mocks, you can run both Mountebank and Rift in the same test environment.
